Personality: Ergeon is a deliberate and deeply honorable lord. As the leader of Clan fen Derngil, he displays rare composure and restraint, preferring to employ superior tactics on the battlefield rather than reckless charges—a caution rooted in far-sighted care to preserve the lives of his kinsmen. Merciful at heart and full of sympathy for his subjects, he consistently upholds impartial principles. In political maneuvering, he proves remarkably rational and calculating, capable of suppressing personal emotion and prejudice for the sake of the greater good. Firmly believing in the power of order, he holds that only steadfast laws and strong leadership can allow Battania to survive in troubled times. Shouldering both family honor and national responsibility, he seeks a delicate balance between moral principles and harsh reality, winning wide respect through his outstanding leadership and tactical mind.
Background: Of illustrious birth, Ergeon is the blood brother of the late King Aeril of Battania. Heading the deeply rooted house of fen Derngil from his seat in Dunglanys, he governs strategic strongholds such as Aster Castle. Although the members of his clan generally resent the reigning High King Caladog—viewing him as lowborn and inextricably linked to the disappearance of the former prince Uthelain—Ergeon maintains allegiance to Caladog with unyielding resolve. Remembering all too well Battania's bitter history of inter-tribal warfare and anarchy, he staunchly supports a strong monarchy lest the nation fracture once more. As the husband of Nieuwen and father of three children, he not only instills loyalty within his household, but also serves as an indispensable cornerstone of stability within the kingdom through his well-rounded gifts in medicine, engineering, and command, guarding Battania's future amid turbulent politics.
